directive: 会話グラフ、分岐条件、前後の返答を読んで、日本語版ゲームの自然な台詞として執筆する。
translation_policy: F:\Games\Radiophobia 3\Translate\Radiophobia 3 会話グラフ翻訳方針.md

entries.EN: Hey man, listen, I've got this one tricky assignment...
entries.JA_current: Hey man, listen, I've got this one tricky assignment...
entries.JA_new: なあ、ちょっと厄介な仕事を引き受けててさ……

entries.EN: ...and you've encountered some difficulties, I suppose, judging from your tone. Am I right?
entries.JA_current: ...and you've encountered some difficulties, I suppose, judging from your tone. Am I right?
entries.JA_new: ……その口ぶりだと、行き詰まったんだろ？ そうじゃないか？

entries.EN: Yes. This is gonna sound like a long shot, but I need codes for secure blast doors in the X-18 lab over in the Dark Valley...
entries.JA_current: Yes. This is gonna sound like a long shot, but I need codes for secure blast doors in the X-18 lab over in the Dark Valley...
entries.JA_new: ああ。無理な頼みだとは思うが、ダークバレーにあるラボX18の防爆扉のコードが要るんだ……

entries.EN: You're poking around in those labs, huh? I wondered when someone would get around to it, finally managed to retrieve those keys to the door, eh?? Well, it just so happens that I was in possession of some documents a while back that mentioned a few codes. I could give them to you for, say, 50 grand?
entries.JA_current: You're poking around in those labs, huh? I wondered when someone would get around to it, finally managed to retrieve those keys to the door, eh?? Well, it just so happens that I was in possession of some documents a while back that mentioned a few codes. I could give them to you for, say, 50 grand?
entries.JA_new: あの研究所を探ってるのか。誰かが動くのを待ってたんだ。ようやく扉の鍵を手に入れたのか？ ちょうど昔、そのコードが載った書類を持ってたんだ。5万ルーブルで教えてやろうか？

entries.EN: Ouch! A pretty penny, I must say. Ugh, what can I do, you've got me by the balls here... Fine, fuck it, here's your money, choke on it!
entries.JA_current: Ouch! A pretty penny, I must say. Ugh, what can I do, you've got me by the balls here... Fine, fuck it, here's your money, choke on it!
entries.JA_new: うっ、高いな……やってくれるじゃないか。だが背に腹は代えられない。くそっ、分かったよ。ほら、持ってけ。喉に詰まらせるなよ！

entries.EN: Holy shit, 50 G's??? I can't afford that buddy, see you around.
entries.JA_current: Holy shit, 50 G's??? I can't afford that buddy, see you around.
entries.JA_new: 5万だって！？ そんな金、払えるわけないだろ。またな。

entries.EN: Pleasure doing business with you, he-he. So here's what was in those papers concerning X-18: there were two administrative levels, each with a unique security clearance- one for junior and assistant researchers, and another for chief science personnel. The levels are apparently separated by heavy blast doors and unlocked by codes, I assume those are the doors that are holding you back, correct? Well, the combinations I had in the paperwork were 1243 and 9524, and should still be valid so long as no one was down there to change them recently, not sure which one fits which door, try them both. Put that in your pipe and smoke it, because I'm not going to repeat it again. Oh, if the codes don't work, don't go crying to me for a refund, the risk was on you and I don't tolerate unsatisfied customers.

entries.JA_new: 取引成立だな、へへ。書類にあったラボX18の情報はこうだ。管理区域は二つに分かれていて、それぞれ別のセキュリティコードがある。一つは新人と補助研究員用、もう一つは主任研究員用だ。頑丈な防爆扉で仕切られていて、コードを入力すれば開く。お前を足止めしてるのも、その扉だろ？ 書類にあった番号は1243と9524だ。最近誰かが変更していなければ、今も使えるはずだ。どっちがどの扉かは分からないから、両方試せ。よく覚えておけよ。二度は言わないからな。ああ、コードが使えなくても返金はしない。そこはお前がリスクを負うんだ。文句を言う客はお断りだ。

entries.EN: Alright, for your sake these codes better work! Thanks...
entries.JA_current: Alright, for your sake these codes better work! Thanks...
entries.JA_new: 分かった。あんたのためにも、コードが使えるといいな。ありがとう……
